Center one dominant subject filling about 75 percent of the canvas, with at most one simple action or effect. Keep the silhouette readable at 32x32. No text, letters, numbers, frame, border, scenery, texture, thin lines, metallic reflections, shine, glow, gradients, particles, or dense detail. Deliberately simple and restrained.
